no_adcom_quote.quote: Not applicable, as no Advisory Committee meeting was held for this application because it did not raise controversial issues that would benefit from outside discussion.

summary: No Advisory Committee meeting was convened for EUCRISA (crisaborole, NDA207695). The FDA review documents (Summary Review, Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, Office Director memo, and Medical Review) all state that the application did not raise controversial, novel, or complex issues warranting outside discussion, noting that although crisaborole is a new molecular entity it is not first-in-class and is topically administered with lower systemic exposure than oral PDE4 inhibitors. Consequently there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
